name: app-store-connect
description: Manage App Store Connect through individually named, typed actions for Apple's published API operations.

interface.shortDescription: Manage App Store Connect with typed API actions.
interface.longDescription: Read reports and manage apps, metadata, TestFlight, reviews, subscriptions, provisioning, and other resources exposed by Apple's App Store Connect API. Every published OpenAPI operation has its own typed action; permissions come from the imported API key. High-impact changes require local browser approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use App Store Connect to manage my apps and reports.
